The story

May 2026

A crossbow. A construction site. A rescue.

Global News: Louka found baby Pepper injured at a construction site in May. He said Pepper and her mother had been shot with a crossbow, and he nursed Pepper back to health.
Sept 2026

One bike ride, and Montreal met the raccoon guy.

CityNews: In September, a video of Louka biking with Pepper on his back went viral.
Early Oct 2026

Then came the warrant.

Montreal Gazette: Officers from Quebec's Environment Ministry served Louka with a search warrant, alleging he was keeping a live raccoon.
26 Oct 2026

Shut out of the refuge, vaccinated on the run.

Yahoo News: Pepper got a rabies shot near Saint-Damien after government restrictions kept the refuge from taking Pepper in. The ministry says euthanasia is a last resort.
